_comment: Single source of truth for PhenoMAP's own product information. The five About pages (frontend/src/views/about/*.vue) render from this file, and the chat-service's PRODUCT_FACTS (chat-service/prompts.py, loaded via chat-service/product_facts.py) is generated from this same file -- so PhenoMAP Chat's answers about PhenoMAP itself can never drift from what the site actually shows. Edit this file, not the .vue files or prompts.py, when this information changes.

identity.main_job: help users explore PhenoMAP's phenotype-metabolite-module knowledge graph through entity lookup, graph relationship retrieval, path queries, module enrichment, and evidence-linked summaries

introduction.hero_tagline: PhenoMAP organizes public human metabolomics studies into a searchable, phenotype-centered knowledge graph.
introduction.overview_heading: A Queryable Graph For Metabolic Modules.
overview_paragraphs: PhenoMAP organizes dysregulated metabolic modules across public human metabolomics studies into a single queryable graph.

FeatureMAP outputs and Metabolomics Workbench metadata are transformed into Study, Phenotype, Module, and Metabolite nodes, with relationships that preserve study context, phenotype labels, module membership, and cross-study module similarity.

The Go API serves search, path, and enrichment queries against Neo4j. The enrichment endpoint calls back into the original R analysis function directly, so the statistical method is not reimplemented in the web layer.

pipeline_steps.title: Prepare Raw Data
pipeline_steps.body: Metabolomics Workbench metadata and per-study FeatureMAP outputs are standardized before graph construction.

pipeline_steps.title: Tidy Entities
pipeline_steps.body: Studies, phenotypes, modules, and metabolites are normalized into graph-ready node tables.

pipeline_steps.title: Build Relationships
pipeline_steps.body: Relationship tables connect studies, phenotypes, modules, and metabolites, including cross-study module similarity.

pipeline_steps.title: Serve Analysis
pipeline_steps.body: The web interface queries Neo4j through the Go API for entity search, path query, and module enrichment.

chatbot_mechanism.heading: How PhenoMAP Chat works
paragraphs: PhenoMAP Chat is a tool-calling assistant, not a text search over documents. For questions about PhenoMAP's own data (an entity, a relationship, an enrichment result), it calls the same search / node-detail / path / enrichment operations that power this website, reads the real results, and answers only from what those calls returned, citing each entity's Lab_ID.
For questions about PhenoMAP Chat or the PhenoMAP project itself, it does not call those tools -- it answers directly from PhenoMAP's own published product information (this same data).
